FACTUAL POSITION & PLEADINGS 1.

Vide this judgment/award, this Tribunal shall decide petition/application/DAR filed for compensation on account of the injuries sustained by injured Jothish Thomas in a road vehicular accident which took place on 21.11.2017 at about 04:00 am at Faridabad - Gurugram Road, Near Liquor Shop within the jurisdiction of PS Suraj Kund, Faridabad, Haryana.
CASE OF THE PETITIONER SIDE 2.1

Succinctly, the case put forward by petition/application/DAR is that on 21.11.2017,

He was driving it, Praveen Thankchan was sitting at front left seat and Gugan Ram was sitting at rear seat.
He was driving his car carefully and at moderate speed.

At about 04:00 am,
when they reached at T-Point of Faridabad - Mehrauli Road, all of a sudden, a pick-up van bearing registration number RJ- 32GB-4659 being driven by its driver in rash and negligent manner came in high speed from front side and hit their car with great force.
As a consequence, they all received various injuries.
Someone called police which took them to Asian Hospital.
He was admitted for treatment and other two persons were declared brought dead.
He received multiple fractures in his legs and chest.
He was operated twice.
His interlocking was also done.
He was discharged from Asian Hospital, however, his treatment continued at ORG Medicare Limited where he remained admitted for several days.
The incident happened due to rash and negligent driving of respondent no.01.

The respondent no.01 being driver, respondent no.02 being owner and respondent no.03 being insurer of the offending vehicle are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation to the petitioner.

HARVINDER SINGH SINGH Date: 2023.05.11 16:50:55 +0530 dismissal of the petition/DAR.
ANALYSIS/FINDINGS ON ISSUES Issue No.(1) :- whether the injured Jothish Thomas suffered injuries in the accident that took place on 21.11.2017 at about 04:00 am due to rash and negligent driving of vehicle bearing registration number RJ-32GB-4659 by the respondent no.01, being owned by respondent no.02 and being insured with respondent no.03?
OPP 9.1

The petitioner/PW1 has deposed that on the day of incident when their car reached T-Point of Faridabad - Mehrauli Road,
the pick-up van bearing registration number RJ-32GB- 4659 came from front side and hit their vehicle.
As a consequence, he suffered many grievous injuries, became unconscious after the incident and other two persons who were traveling with him died at the spot.
The date and time of incident in this matter is 21.11.2017 at about 03:00 am.
The R3W1 Ct. Anil has deposed that on said day, he was on patrolling duty at PCR No.22 with Ct. Satya Narain.
On receipt of information, he reached at the spot and found Wagon-R car bearing registration number DL-9CL-2790 in accidental condition and three persons lying in it in injured condition.
Ambulance was called and ambulance personnels found the petitioner/injured in senses and other two persons dead.
He informed the Chowki Incharge R3W2 who reached at the spot and recorded his statement Ex.R3W3/1 on which FIR No.1021/2017 of PS Suraj Kund, Faridabad was registered.
The witness R3W2 has deposed that on reaching at the spot, he found only damaged Wagon-R car bearing registration number DL-9CL-2790 belonging to the victim.
The injured Jothish Thomas was not found fit for statement till 25.11.2017 and his statement could be recorded Jothish Thomas Vs. Raj Mohd. & Ors.

The injured Jothish Thomas in his statement recorded by R3W2 on 26.11.2017 (part of Ex.PW1/3) has stated the number of offending vehicle as RJ- 32GB-4659.

The R3W4 SI Satbir Singh who was 2 nd IO after R3W2 has deposed that when the investigation of the case was handed over to him, the name and address of accused driver and registration number of offending vehicle were not available.
He traced the offending vehicle from number plate which was found at the place of incident.
He deposed that the injured Jothish Thomas never informed him about the registration number of offending vehicle.

He arrested the respondent no.01/driver of offending vehicle, seized the offending vehicle bearing registration number RJ-32GB-4659 and also got it mechanically inspected vide Ex.R3W4/2 from Motor Mechanic ASI Ravinder on 19.12.2017.
It is clear from the copy of charge-sheet submitted on record that offending vehicle was mentioned as unknown vehicle in statement of R3W1 upon which FIR was registered.
There is no mention of any number plate or any front bumper of offending vehicle being found at the place of incident on the date of incident.

2023.05.11 16:51:10 +0530 of these facts, if the deposition of the respondent no.01/driver of offending vehicle R3W5 is examined, he was not even able to tell the route taken by him from Gurugram to Faridabad on the day of incident.
It is hard to believe that one can forget the route of such a major incident if such incident has taken place with his/her vehicle.

He has also deposed that the bumper of his vehicle fell at the place of incident, but same is again not in consonance with the statement of R3W1 on whose statement the FIR was registered and the statement of 1 st IO/R3W2.
Similarly, deposition of respondent no.02/owner of vehicle bearing registration number RJ-32GB-4659 is also surprising as he could not tell what damage was suffered by his vehicle in the incident.
He could not tell the name of workshop where his vehicle was repaired.
He was also not able to furnish any bill of repair.
It is also quite surprising that he has not claimed damages from the insurance company despite his vehicle being fully insured.

The Mechanical Inspector ASI Ravinder Kumar who inspected the vehicle bearing registration number RJ-32GB-4659 on 19.12.2017 has not found any fresh damages on the vehicle as is clear from his report Ex.R3W4/2 on record.
He has not even found any fresh repair work being done on said vehicle in his inspection.
